channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Meta to Shut Messenger Website in April 2026, Redirecting Users to Facebook Platform: Reports
item.description: Meta will discontinue messenger.com on 15 April 2026, requiring desktop users to access chats through Facebook while mobile apps remain unaffected.

item.title: Loosening Pyjama String is ‘Attempt to Rape’: Supreme Court Overrules Controversial Allahabad HC Ruling on Sexual Intent
item.description: SC ruled that groping a minor and loosening her garment string crossed from preparation to attempt, restoring serious charges and calling for nationwide judicial sensitivity reforms.

item.title: Diagnosed With Polio at 6, Gujarat’s Maya Bhammar Lifts National Silver at 23rd Para Powerlifting Championship
item.description: Gujarat’s Maya Bhammar overcame childhood polio and years of challenges to clinch silver at the 23rd Senior National Para Powerlifting Championship, inspiring renewed conversations around inclusion in Indian sports.

item.title: Marriage Talks Turn Violent: 19-Year-Old Tripura Student Brutally Assaulted by Live-In Partner in Gurugram
item.description: A biotechnology student was hospitalised at AIIMS Delhi after her partner allegedly assaulted her over suspicion, prompting arrest and investigation.

item.title: Dowry Harassment Escalates to Digital Abuse: Rewa Man Arrested for Circulating Wife’s 13-Minute Private Video in Madhya Pradesh
item.description: After months of dowry harassment, Rewa woman accused husband of circulating private video, arrest followed.

item.title: ‘Not an Act of Charity’: Bombay High Court Says Child Raised by Single Mother Need Not Carry Father’s Surname
item.description: In a landmark ruling, the Bombay High Court directed authorities to update a 12-year-old’s school records, affirming that a child raised solely by a mother cannot be forced to carry an absent father’s name or caste.

item.title: Loudspeaker Dispute Triggers Stone-Pelting in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh: Temple Grill Damaged, 15 Detained
item.description: A disagreement over loudspeaker use at a Durga temple escalated into stone-pelting, minor clashes, and detentions in Jabalpur.

item.title: Hyderabad Biryani Probe Using AI Exposes ₹70,000 Crore Restaurant Tax Evasion Across India
item.description: A routine inspection of biryani restaurants in Hyderabad expanded into a nationwide AI-led investigation uncovering alleged suppression of ₹70,000 crore in restaurant sales over six years.

item.title: Bagalkot, Karnataka: Stone-Pelting During Shivaji Jayanti Procession Injures Police Officer, Prohibitory Orders Imposed
item.description: Stone-pelting near a mosque during a Shivaji Jayanti rally in Bagalkot injured a police officer, prompted security clampdowns, and led to prohibitory orders amid appeals for calm.

item.title: 1 Arrest in Madhubani: Bihar Police Bust Pakistan-Linked Fake Currency Racket via Nepal Border
item.description: A joint police and SSB operation in Bihar’s Madhubani has uncovered alleged links to a cross-border counterfeit currency network routed through Nepal.
